_meta.title: Bible Catalog — 25 Sampled Verses (Lean On-Device Schema)
_meta.description: Lean mobile & on-device LLM schema. Each verse carries only its longhand `visual_prompt`, `spec_id`, and `humanizer` stage (`S2` for nature/objects; `S4` when people silhouettes from the back are included). Full prompt templates, negative tokens, filter parameters, and signature rules are resolved via `FHG_VISUAL_SPEC_REGISTRY.json`.

rules.fhg_sketch_people_spec: Humanizer S4 (human silhouettes seen from the back — ~10% of verses)

_meta.humanizer_rule: G2+S2 for nature, architecture & grounded objects; G2+S3 LOCKED whenever human silhouettes (seen strictly from the back) are included.

verses.text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.plain: For everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
verses.visual_prompt: a solitary stone cairn marking a quiet hilltop trail under an open parchment sky

verses.text: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
verses.plain: He has answered the prayer of the destitute and hasn't turned their prayer away.
verses.visual_prompt: an empty clay bowl resting on a rough stone ledge beside a trickling spring

verses.text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
verses.plain: Hope that keeps getting put off makes your heart sick — but a longing finally met feels like new life.
verses.visual_prompt: a wide-canopied fig tree rooted in rocky soil behind a low dry-stone wall

verses.text: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
verses.plain: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church prayed to God for him without stopping.
verses.visual_prompt: a small clay oil lamp burning quietly on a rough-hewn stone windowsill

verses.text: For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.
verses.plain: For he says, 'In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.' I tell you, now is the time of God's favor; now is the day of salvation.
verses.visual_prompt: an open wooden gate in an old stone courtyard wall leading out to a sunlit pasture

verses.text: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.plain: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is flawless; he is a shield to all who take refuge in him.
verses.visual_prompt: a massive overhanging crag of weathered rock sheltering a quiet mountain path

verses.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to the Lord, our God, until he has mercy on us.
verses.plain: Just as servants watch their master's hand, we keep our eyes on the Lord our God until he shows us mercy.
verses.visual_prompt: a robed shepherd seen from the back standing quietly in the mid-ground beside a low dry-stone fieldstone wall with a wooden staff in hand looking out toward the rolling Judean hills

verses.text: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.plain: As they stoned Stephen, he prayed, 'Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.'
verses.visual_prompt: a scattered pile of rough fieldstones at the base of a quiet olive tree

verses.text: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.plain: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?'
verses.visual_prompt: a solitary cloaked traveler seen from behind walking along a stony desert road between rough boulders toward distant hills

verses.text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
verses.plain: We tear down arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take every thought captive to make it obey Christ.
verses.visual_prompt: an old tumbledown stone ruin overgrown with quiet wild grass and olive shoots

verses.text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.plain: Those who are wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever.
verses.visual_prompt: a quiet rocky ridge in simple fountain-pen contour beneath a vast, clear horizon

verses.text: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.plain: So don't be afraid — you're worth far more than a whole flock of sparrows.
verses.visual_prompt: a single small sparrow perched on a twisted olive branch above a stone wall

verses.text: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
verses.plain: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they existed and were created.
verses.visual_prompt: an ancient gnarled cedar standing alone on a stony mountain ridge

verses.text: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.plain: See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
verses.visual_prompt: two robed travelers seen from the back walking together along a narrow footpath bordered by stacked fieldstones winding peacefully into a quiet valley

verses.text: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.plain: You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.
verses.visual_prompt: a stone well in a quiet clearing with a wooden bucket resting on its rim

verses.text: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.plain: They've hit me hard again and again since I was young — but they've never beaten me.
verses.visual_prompt: a wind-bent olive tree with thick roots gripping a rocky hillside

verses.text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.plain: Set your mind on things above, not on earthly things.
verses.visual_prompt: a stone steps path climbing up a quiet hillside toward an open sky

verses.text: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
verses.plain: So it doesn't depend on human desire or effort, but on God's mercy.
verses.visual_prompt: a quiet brook flowing gently between mossy stones in an open meadow

verses.text: Set a watch, Lord, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
verses.plain: Lord, set a guard over my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.
verses.visual_prompt: a heavy latched wooden door set into a quiet, thick stone wall

verses.text: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
verses.plain: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not, sin is crouching at your door; it desires to have you, but you must rule over it.
verses.visual_prompt: a rough stone threshold at the entrance of a simple dwelling with thorn bushes beside the step

verses.text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.plain: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.visual_prompt: a stone fountain basin brimming over onto flat courtyard flagstones

verses.text: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
verses.plain: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him.
verses.visual_prompt: an open rock-hewn garden tomb with a rolled-away stone beside blooming olive branches

verses.text: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.plain: That's when fear grips them — because God is with the people who do right.
verses.visual_prompt: a sturdy stone watchtower standing firm in a rocky field under a billowing cloud

verses.text: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments.
verses.plain: so they'd put their hope in God, never forget the things he's done, and keep his commands.
verses.visual_prompt: twelve stacked river stones standing as a quiet memorial beside a riverbank

verses.text: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.plain: Healthy people don't need a doctor — sick people do. I didn't come for those who think they're fine, but for those who know they've failed.
verses.visual_prompt: a mended clay pitcher resting beside a small olive-oil flask on a wooden table
